snippet.description:
Immerse yourself in the devotion and timeless folk traditions of Chhath Puja with “Kelwa Ke Paat Par”, a much-loved traditional Bhojpuri Chhath song in the soulful voice of Sharda Sinha.

Celebrated for its deep cultural roots and devotional spirit, this evergreen Chhath Geet beautifully reflects the faith, rituals and traditions associated with Chhathi Maiya and Surya Dev. Its melodious folk charm brings alive the atmosphere of Chhath celebrations, from the preparations at home to the devotional moments at the Chhath Ghat.

Make your Chhath Puja celebrations more special with this timeless Bhojpuri folk classic. Listen, share and enjoy the beautiful voice of Sharda Sinha with your family and friends.
